chart.heading: Over time — circuit {id}

footer.check.failed: Looking did not work; try again later
footer.channel.betaHint: You get every new version. Switch to Stable under Settings.
machines.heading: Machines and efficiency
machines.measuredNote: Efficiency is a measurement the game averages over recent time — a machine that just stopped fades down rather than dropping. For generators the percentage is the load the circuit puts on them, not how well they run.
overlay.tray.clickThrough: Let clicks through to the game
update.tooltip: Version {version} is ready. Click for what changes and how updating works.
update.title: Update to version {version}
update.how: The game can keep running: it never has to close for an update of FICSIT Live. After you confirm, FICSIT Live closes for about half a minute. The overlay and the dashboard are briefly gone, and the bridge starts again with the new version. This page then reloads by itself.
update.installing: Updating. This page reloads by itself.
update.slow: This takes longer than expected. Is FICSIT Live back in the system tray? If not, look at updater.log in %APPDATA%\FICSIT Live.
update.failed: The update could not start. Try again in a moment.
network.heading: Map and transport network
network.inferred: inferred, not reported by the game
network.pickHint: Click a node to see what it connects to. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom.
network.noConnections: No connections found on this node
network.noFlowYet: Throughput is derived, not measured: the game measures what a machine makes and takes, never what runs over a belt or through a pipe. Every figure carries how hard it is. Where the factory allows no answer it reads “not derivable”, never zero.
network.flow.coverage: {known} of {total} belts and pipes have a throughput ({percent}%)
network.flow.grades: {pinned} from one reading · {balanced} from several · {modelled} with a rule added
network.flow.conflicts: Contradicting readings: {count}. No figure is published there.
network.certainty.pinned.hint: The measured rate of the machine on this connection. The only assumption is that the two are attached.
network.certainty.balanced.hint: Measured rates added and subtracted where connections join and part. Bookkeeping, with no assumption about behaviour.
network.certainty.modelled.hint: Rests on a rule besides the readings: how a splitter divides what is left over, or what a generator burns for the power it gives.
network.certainty.unknown.hint: Not derivable from what the game reports. No figure belongs here, and certainly not a zero.
network.power.noBuildings: No known building hangs on this stretch
network.power.poleGuess: An estimate: a pole or a wall outlet. The game does not say which.
network.power.towerWhy: This tower carries a cable of over 100 m, and a cable that long only fits a tower.
network.resources.statesTip: Free: nothing stands on it. Not fully used: a miner, oil extractor or fracking extractor stands on it and gets less than 95% of its own setting, because its belt or pipe backs up or it is paused. In use: the rest; a geyser with a geothermal generator on it always counts as in use.
network.resources.takenUnknown: Something stands on it, but the machine reading does not name it yet.
network.trains.heading: Trains ({count})
nav.label: Pages
settings.heading: Settings
settings.unmanaged: These settings belong to the installed FICSIT Live app. This bridge was not started by the app (it runs from the working copy or as a separate trial), so there is nothing to change here.
settings.intro: What you change here, the app writes to its own files in %APPDATA%\FICSIT Live. Edit those files by hand and it shows here too.
settings.savedLive: Saved, and in effect right away.
settings.error.sameHotkey: The same hotkey twice will not work: pick another one for click-through.
settings.error.localesDirMissing: That folder has no en.json, so it is not a folder of translations.
settings.error.notLocal: These settings can only be changed from the pc itself.
settings.error.unmanaged: This bridge was not started by the app, so there is nothing to save.
settings.error.noAnswer: The app did not answer. Try again. If it keeps happening, look in app.log in %APPDATA%\FICSIT Live.
settings.overlay.heading: Overlay
settings.overlay.note: Takes effect right away, even while the game runs. Can be changed from a tablet too.
settings.overlay.showOnGameStart: Show the overlay as soon as the game starts
settings.overlay.hideWhenUnfocused: Hide the overlay when you alt-tab out of the game
settings.overlay.startClickThrough: Let clicks through to the game when it opens
settings.app.heading: App
settings.app.note: Can only be changed from this pc.
settings.app.pcOnly: These settings can only be changed from the pc itself, not from a tablet or another device.
settings.app.openAtLogin: Start FICSIT Live when you sign in to Windows
settings.app.checkForUpdates: Look for a new version every half hour
settings.app.channel.stable: Stable: only the big versions, such as 0.4 to 0.5
settings.app.channel.beta: Beta: every new version, the small ones in between too
settings.app.channel.hint: Going from Beta to Stable never takes you back to an older version: you stay on this one until there is a newer stable one.
settings.app.restartHeading: In effect after a bridge restart
settings.app.hostNetwork: Also a tablet or another device on your network
settings.restart.title: Restart the bridge
settings.restart.toLocal: Afterwards the bridge can only be reached from this pc.
settings.restart.toNetwork: Afterwards the bridge can also be reached from a tablet or another device on your network. Windows may ask once whether FICSIT Live may pass the firewall.
settings.restart.localesShipped: The translations come from the install itself again.
settings.restart.localesDir: The translations come from {dir}. Anything missing there comes from the install.
settings.restart.how: The game can keep running, and so can the overlay. Only the bridge stops and starts again at once. This page and the overlay go without data for a few seconds and then reconnect by themselves.
settings.restart.tabletWarning: Note: a tablet watching now will lose its connection.
settings.restart.busy: The bridge is restarting. This page reconnects by itself.
settings.restart.slow: This is taking longer than expected. Look in bridge.log in %APPDATA%\FICSIT Live.
planner.heading: Production planner
planner.goals.heading: What you make
planner.rules.heading: Rules
planner.result.heading: The plan
planner.noBook: The bridge has no recipes yet: neither the game nor a saved copy answered.
planner.noGoals: No starting point yet. Pick an end product below and say how much you want per minute, or pick a resource and say how much of it you have.
planner.goalItem: Search an end product or a resource
planner.goal.fix.time.hint: You say how long it may take; the planner works out how much per minute that is.
planner.goal.fix.rate.hint: You say how much per minute; the planner works out how long it takes.
planner.goal.covered: Already in storage: {stock}. Nothing needs to be built for it.
planner.goal.noStock: Storage not read yet, nothing comes off
planner.goal.noPace: enter a time or a rate
planner.goal.burn.hint: Where the rods go. Choose a power plant and the plan adds the reactors, their water and their waste.
planner.goal.power.hint: You say how much power you want; the planner works out how many rods a minute that is.
planner.goal.max.hint: As much as your limits and what you have allow, after the fixed end products.
planner.goal.max.open: Nothing limits this end product. Set a number on a node as a limit, or say what you have.
planner.goal.max.failed: The planner could not work out the most.
planner.goal.max.nothingLeft: Nothing possible: the fixed goals take everything you have.
planner.goal.share: Share of {item} next to the other goals on as much as possible
planner.goal.share.hint: Several goals on as much as possible keep this ratio. 2 to 1 is twice as much of the first.
planner.profile.label: Best means
planner.profile.scarcity.hint: As little raw resource as possible, each weighted by how scarce it is on the whole map: uranium counts far more than iron ore.
planner.profile.machines.hint: As few machines as possible, whatever it costs in ore; resources and power only break ties.
planner.profile.power.hint: As little power as possible at 100% clock; resources and machines only break ties.
planner.fluids.label: Fluids
planner.fluids.leftover.hint: Fluid that is left over stays left over. The plan says which; in the game you have to get rid of it yourself, in a tank or a generator.
planner.fluids.consume.hint: Every fluid made is used again. Packaging it and leaving the package does not count as using it.
planner.fluids.sink.hint: A fluid left over may go into a sink once packaged. The plan counts the packagers and the empty containers, since those go into the sink with it. What cannot be packaged must be used up.
planner.clock.label: Clock up to
planner.clock.hint: The planner raises a step's clock only where that saves a machine, and never above this limit; what it costs in power and power shards is shown with it.
planner.sloops.label: Somersloops
planner.sloops.none.hint: No somersloops, except on a step where you set them yourself.
planner.sloops.full.hint: Every machine that takes them gets all its slots filled: twice the output from the same input, for four times the power. That saves raw resources too. The Packager takes none.
planner.boost.heading: Clock and somersloops for this step
planner.parts.heading: Parts
planner.parts.intro: Every item in this plan, from the goal down: how much flows through it, where it comes from and where it goes. Step 1 goes straight into a goal.
planner.recipe.heading: Recipe for this item
planner.error: The bridge could not plan this. Is it running?
planner.failed: The solver gave up on this plan. That should not happen; please note which goals you asked.
planner.bookFrom: Recipes as read from the game at {time}. Which recipes this project uses is chosen on the Recipes page.
planner.stock.from: Storage and Dimensional Depot as read at {time}.
planner.stock.fromNoDepot: Storage as read at {time}. The Dimensional Depot did not answer and does not count.
planner.stock.parts: For a total the goal's own stock comes off first. What still lies there feeds the parts, spread over {minutes} minutes: the longest duration of the goals.
planner.stock.partsFlowGoal: For a total the goal's own stock comes off. The stock of the parts does not count, because there is also a goal per minute, and that runs on once the stock is gone.
planner.stock.none: The bridge has not read the storage yet, so nothing comes off a total.
planner.surplus.heading: Your factory's surplus
planner.surplus.intro: What your factory makes too much of among the items in this plan: per belt network, what goes into a container with no way out or into a sink. A machine standing still because its output is full counts at what its clock allows. Tick what this project may use; you then lay a belt to that network. The plan never takes more than the surplus, and only what it needs.
planner.surplus.unread: The bridge has not worked out the throughput yet, so the surplus is not known.
planner.surplus.none: Your factory has no surplus of the items in this plan that ends in storage or a sink.
planner.layout.label: View
planner.canvas.hint: The canvas arranges itself: ingredients left of what they feed. Drag a node by its title to pin it; Arrange puts everything back in place. Drag the background to move around, zoom with the wheel. Open a node's ingredients to draw them in. You can type over any number on a node: it becomes a limit, and everything is worked out again.
planner.canvas.arrangeHint: Put the nodes you dragged back in place as well
planner.canvas.resize: Drag to make the canvas taller or shorter
planner.spread.label: Spread somersloops
planner.spread.hint: How many somersloops do you have? The planner looks for where they save the most machines. Your own steps stay as they are and count.
planner.spread.error: No proposal: the bridge did not answer.
planner.spread.none: There is no proposal for this plan.
planner.spread.result: Proposal: {used} of the {budget} somersloops, {machines} machines instead of {without}. Steps with somersloops: {steps}.
planner.spread.over: Your own steps already take {used} somersloops, more than {budget}.
planner.spread.proven: With this number it cannot be done with fewer machines.
planner.spread.kept: The proposal already in the project is at least as good and stays.
planner.spread.taken: Steps with somersloops from a proposal for {budget}: {steps}. Ask again to move them; your own steps stay as they are.
planner.canvas.lockedHint: You have not unlocked the recipe {recipe} yet; the plan uses it because it is switched on in this project. How to get it: {how}. Switch it off at this step or on the Recipes page to plan without it.
planner.total.powerTrains: {machines} MW for the machines and {trains} MW for the locomotives at their peak
planner.transport.noReading: The bridge has not read any trains and stations yet.
planner.transport.noStations: There are not yet two stations in the game.
planner.transport.noPorts: There are not yet two drone ports in the game.
planner.transport.goneTrain: a train that is no longer there
planner.transport.drones: {count} drone(s), each with a pair of ports
planner.transport.trains: {count} × this train, {wagons} wagon(s) for this item
planner.transport.estimateHint: Estimated: {meters} m one way along the rails (or straight plus 10%), at a speed that is lower on a short ride because of pulling away and braking, and 27 s per platform stop. As soon as a train runs on this line, the measured round trip counts.
planner.transport.estimateDroneHint: Estimated: {meters} m straight, 75 m/s on batteries and 102 s taking off and landing, 4 batteries a round trip. Not checked: there is no drone port yet. Once the port flies, what it reports counts.
planner.transport.power: {megawatts} MW for the locomotives at their peak
planner.transport.batteries: {perMinute} batteries a minute, counted in the plan
planner.transport.problem.unknownStation: One of the stations or ports does not exist (any more).
planner.transport.problem.noRoute: No rail runs between these stations, or the train has no wagons for this item.
planner.transport.problem.noStack: The stack size of this item has not been seen yet. Put one in a container and the bridge counts the wagons.
planner.transport.problem.fluidByDrone: A drone carries no fluid, only its packaged form.
planner.transport.onMap: A new line: points on the map
planner.transport.noReadingPoints: The bridge has not read any trains, stations or ports yet. Points on the map still work.
planner.transport.pick: Point it out on the map
planner.transport.picked: {straight} m in a straight line, {meters} m with the 10% surcharge
planner.transport.pickTitle: Point it out on the map
planner.transport.pickNoMap: The map is not there yet: the bridge has not reached the game.
planner.transport.pickHint: Click to set a point. Drag to move the map, scroll to zoom. Esc or Cancel changes nothing.
planner.transport.estimateBeltHint: Estimated: the straight line between the two points plus 10%. A belt draws no power.
planner.transport.caveat.radioactiveByDr: The wiki does not say whether a drone may carry radioactive waste. Counted, but not checked: try it in the game.
planner.transport.problem.fluidByBelt: A belt carries no fluid, only its packaged form.
planner.transport.problem.beltLocked: You have not unlocked a conveyor belt yet.
planner.transport.beltLimit: Mk.{mark} is the fastest belt you have, so {count} side by side. With Mk.6 you would need {all}.
planner.total.netHint: Generated minus what the machines and locomotives of this plan draw. What is left, the rest of your factory can use.
planner.end.burned: Into the power plant: {rate} per minute
planner.end.lockedHint: On the way the plan uses recipes you do not have yet: {recipes}.
planner.end.blocked: Cannot be processed. The project lacks: {items}
planner.end.noStack: The stack size is unknown, so the storage cannot be counted.
planner.end.thenHint: Where what is left goes: nowhere, a power plant or the sink.
planner.end.processHint: {rate} {unit} arrives here. What you process is used up entirely, into {item}. The rest is left over.
planner.machines.heading: Machines per recipe
planner.powerVaries: This machine's draw varies; this is its average.
planner.unknownPower: Power unknown for: {machines}. Counted as zero.
planner.raw.heading: Raw resources
planner.byproducts.fluidNote: A fluid cannot go into a sink. Choose “Must be used up” or “Packaged into a sink” under Fluids to plan them away.
planner.blocked.heading: This cannot be made yet
planner.blocked.goal: {item} cannot be made with the recipes this project uses:
planner.reason.noRecipe: no recipe makes it; it is gathered, not produced
planner.reason.notAllowed: only recipes switched off in this project make it
planner.reason.cycle: the recipes you have only feed each other
planner.reason.notAvailable: is not under What you have, and the rest does not come from the ground
planner.fluidsLeft.heading: Only possible with fluid left over
planner.fluidsLeft.text: This project's recipes can make this, but not without leaving these over. Choose another setting under Fluids, or switch on an alternate that uses them.
planner.alternates.heading: Alternates that make the plan better
planner.alternates.intro: Alternates only take part once you switch them on: here, at a step above, or on the Recipes page. Each is tried on its own: how much better the plan gets with it, and how you get it if you do not have it yet.
planner.alternates.none: No alternate that is off makes this plan better.
planner.total.lockedHint: Recipes in this plan you have not unlocked. Each says how you get it.
planner.project.label: Projects
planner.project.name: Project name
planner.project.confirmDelete: Delete project “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
planner.project.saving.failed: Not saved: the bridge refused or cannot be reached
planner.project.offline: This bridge does not keep projects yet; what you do here is gone on reload
planner.project.hideHint: Take this project out of the row. It stays saved, under Hidden.
planner.project.showHint: Put this project back in the row
planner.project.hiddenTab: This project is hidden; it shows here because it is open
planner.project.dragHint: Click to open, drag to move
planner.available.heading: What you have
planner.available.intro: Say what you have, per minute: a resource such as Crude Oil, or an intermediate product. The plan never takes more of it, and does not make it either. Set a goal to As much as possible to see how much you can make with it.
planner.available.rate: How much {item} you have per minute
planner.available.usedUp: used up, this limits the plan
planner.available.rest.label: The rest
planner.available.rest.ground.hint: What is not on the list comes from the ground as always. The plan shows how much.
planner.available.rest.only.hint: The plan uses only what is on the list, and water. If something is missing, it says what.
planner.short.heading: Your limits or what you have are not enough
planner.short.text: These end products can be made, but not within your limits or with what you entered under What you have. Lower an end product, or set it to As much as possible to see what can be done.
planner.limit.label: at most
planner.limit.node: Per minute through {item}; a number here is a limit
planner.limit.hint: A limit: no more goes through this node than this, wherever it comes from. With several limits the tightest wins.
planner.limit.tightHint: Production comes up against this: this limit decides how much end product there is.
planner.limit.unused: nothing is made of it yet
planner.limit.tightRow: Tightest: production comes up against this, {rate} {unit} goes through.
planner.limit.unusedRow: Nothing is made of it yet. Choose Make of this… under its node on the canvas.
planner.make.loading: Working out what you can make of this…
planner.make.error: The bridge could not work out what you can make of this.
planner.make.intro: With {rate} {unit} {item}, and the rest as this project says:
planner.make.empty: With these recipes there is nothing {item} holds back.
planner.make.none: Cannot be made with these recipes and limits ({count})
recipes.heading: Recipes
recipes.projectCount: {project} uses {allowed} of the {total} recipes; you have unlocked {unlocked}.
recipes.bulk.standard.hint: Every standard recipe, also what you do not have yet, and no alternates.
installer.installed: FICSIT Live {version} is installed and running. It is in the Start menu and starts by itself when you log in. The dashboard is at http://localhost:{port}/, and the overlay appears once the game runs (F9).
installer.dataKept: Your projects and settings are still in {folder}. Delete that folder if you no longer need them.
